breakdown.description: `dc2` is treated as the interstitial-containing defect complex even though it is built without the H interstitial.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The generated specification states: 'The function builds a defect complex dc2 from the same substitution and vacancy, but it will be used to represent the complex including the H interstitial for certain properties.' This directly repeats the flawed logic from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth corrected this by instructing to build a second defect complex that actually includes the interstitial from its creation, not just treating an identical complex differently.
